name: K3-1C-1-7, 1BDR
headline: Cool & Curated 1BDR @ Kamaran El Gouna
summary: Kamaran is a lively family neighborhood that presents multiple lifestyle amenities to explore and enjoy.

description.Space:
This 1 bedroom apartment is located in Gouna's Kamaran community.

It features a spacious living room overlooking a Pool, a walk in fully equipped kitchen and 1 bedroom and sofa bed that can sleep 3 guests comfortably. 

It also features a 55 inch smart TV with Airplay and cable channels, washing machine, a Nespresso machine, kettle and a microwave. 

At Xuru Stays, we’re committed to providing our guests the magical hospitality they deserve.
description.Access: Guests have access to the entire property
description.Interaction: We are more than happy to answer all of your questions. Guests can text and call anytime they need help and our team will be there in about 30 mins to solve any issue immediately.
description.Neighborhood: Kamaran is a lively family neighborhood that presents multiple lifestyle amenities to explore and enjoy.
description.Transit:
Free outdoor parking is available. 
Tuktuks are available to take you anywhere in El Gouna (flat fee).
description.Notes: Please note that smoking is not allowed inside the apartment. A fine of $100 may be imposed in case of smoking indoors.

agreement:
﻿• Kindly note that a damage deposit of USD 100 (or the equivalent in EGP) is required. The payment is collected online as part of the reservation payment and will be reimbursed on the checkout day, provided no damages are incurred.
  • Smoking (including shisha) inside the unit is strictly not allowed. However it is allowed in the unit’s balcony (if applicable). A fine of $100 may be imposed in case of smoking indoors.
 • Partying, excessive noise and public alcohol drinking is not allowed. In case of violations, security will be notified and appropriate strict actions will be taken. 
 • Visitors are not allowed, only confirmed guests stated in the reservation will be granted entry. 
• Egyptian & Arab couples ONLY are required to provide proof of marriage according to Egyptian law. Guests are required to send their IDs or passports to the email (id@xurustays.com) or (id.elgouna@xurustays.com) as per the local regulations.
• El Gouna entry permits require 48 hours to be issued, in case guest IDs and passports are sent less than 48 hours before check in date, entry permits are subject to delay or may not be granted. (In case of disapproval from community security office, guests will be fully refunded).
 • Cancellation more than 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 10% of the total price of the stay.
 • Cancellation between 15 days and 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 50% of the total price of the stay. 
• Cancellation between 7 days and 15 days before the arrival date, we keep 75% of the total price of the stay.
• Less than 7 days, we keep 100% of the price of the stay
• Pets are not allowed, in case of violation, Xuru Stays has the right to cancel the reservation with no refund. 

Thank you for choosing our home for your Holiday.
We hope that you have a pleasant stay.

Xuru Stays

We stayed in the unit for 6 days. We really enjoyed our stay. The compound was perfect for our liking, it was very peaceful, safe and quiet. It is still a new compound so the furniture and utilities of the unit were very well kept.

The place was spacious, there was a pool in the compound which was lovely, but the cleanliness of the pool was not maintained.

The location of the compound is next to the gate, a bit further from the downtown in elgouna, but we could easily go there by car or toktok in 10 minutes.

We especially loved the safety of the place. The numbers of the units and buildings letters were a bit confusing, so finding our unit after a night out was an adventure, but we got the grasp of it after a few days. 

The xuru team were responsive and prompt with their answers making sure our stay was comfortable and our needs were being met.

Thank you xuru team for this lovely experience. 

Ww recommend this init if you’re looking for a place to relax and wind .

Sehr schönes Apartment in einer neuen Gegend von El Gouna. Daher sind die Häuser dort alle sehr neu und schick. Es ist relativ ruhig, auch wenn an weiteren Häusern - vor allen Dingen am Morgen - gebaut wird. Die Poollandschaft ist schön und der Pool kann von allen Bewohnern genutzt werden. Die Wohnung an sich ist sauber, auch wenn der Boden sauberer hätte sein können. Die Küche ist mit allem ausgestattet, was man zum Kochen braucht. Hilfreich wären einige Schilder für die Schalter in der Wohnung gewesen, wir haben bspw. einen Schalter für das Warmwasser umgelegt und wussten dann nicht, warum wir kein warmes Wasser mehr hatten. Der Gastgeber hat aber auf Fragen immer schnell reagiert. Verärgert waren wir über die Auscheckzeit von 11 Uhr. Das ist unserer Meinung nach viel zu früh, zumal penibel darauf geachtet wird, erst ab 15 Uhr einzuchecken. Niemand braucht 4 Stunden um alles zu säubern. Das sollte verbessert werden und mindestens bis 12 Uhr sollte es möglich sein, auszuchecken.
